subject.title: fix(sessions): commit reduced session index before deleting evicted transcripts

question: Should direct callers of exported `enforceSessionDiskBudget` that lack a durable index commit boundary intentionally retain evicted artifacts and report the disk target unmet?
rationale: The safer behavior prevents irreversible transcript loss but changes reclamation semantics for lower-level callers, and repository evidence cannot establish whether all external callers can supply a durable boundary.

options.title: Approve fail-safe retention
options.body: Accept that callers without a durable boundary retain artifacts and may remain over budget because index/transcript consistency takes precedence over reclamation.

options.title: Require an explicit boundary API
options.body: Restructure the exported API so destructive eviction cannot be requested without an explicit durable-commit capability or a separate planning phase.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-safe retention
recommendation.body: Accept that callers without a durable boundary retain artifacts and may remain over budget because index/transcript consistency takes precedence over reclamation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history most directly connects them to the session-maintenance design and cleanup semantics affected by this choice.
